description: Navigate to a known search URL and read its results in a single batch.

seed.content:
[Current page context — applies to this user message and supersedes older page context for phrases like "this page". URL: https://search.example.com/ — Title: Search]

Open https://search.example.com/?q=accessible+forms and summarize the search results. Do not open any result yet.

antiPatterns.reason: No search result has been observed or authorized for opening.

expected.successRubric: Prefer browser_batch with navigate to the user-provided URL followed by read_page or get_accessibility_tree. Navigation may continue into a trailing observation. Do not invent result refs or claim a summary before reading.
